summary: After two environment-only NOT_VERIFIED rounds with zero runtime execution, R3 dispatch is intentionally blocked. Environment repair is dispatched first. The preparation actor must physically transfer the exact Linux double Godot archive into a reachable Ubuntu environment, verify archive SHA, binary SHA and exact version, materialize a fresh detached exact P7.4 worktree, prove tracked-clean and runner presence, and stop before executing the runtime gate. Only a durable ENVIRONMENT_READY status READY plus Project Control SUCCESS may open fresh Ubuntu Verifier R3.
